# Tool

> Tool lifecycle helpers with anti-duplication UIDs.

- Package: `Tool` · Category: Gameplay & world
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Tool")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Tool")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Tool`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/ToolService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Tool = GaxiaServer.Tool
```

### Functions

- `Tool.Create(itemId: string, props: { [string]: any }?): Tool`
  Create a fresh Tool with a unique UID + ItemId. Returns the Tool unparented.
- `Tool.Give(player: Player, itemId: string, props: { [string]: any }?): Tool?`
  Create + parent to player.Backpack so it appears in their hotbar immediately.
- `Tool.Track(tool: Tool): ()`
  Register a tool in the anti-dupe registry. If its UID already exists, this is the duplicate — destroy it instead of the original.
- `Tool.IsTracked(tool: Tool): boolean`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Tool.OnDuplicate` — `Signal<Tool>`
  (tool) when a duplicate UID is detected — fired just before the duplicate is destroyed
